name: intake_pipeline_nested
description: Nested/referenced workflow: the intake node embeds the standalone 'support_ticket_router' workflow as a sub-graph, then adds a local audit step. Proves workflows can compose by reference with no Rust changes.

is_noise.instructions: Is this message noise that should be dropped before routing?

criteria.A: no, it is a real request that needs routing
criteria.B: yes, it is automated noise or a duplicate

needs_human.instructions: Given the routing outcome, does a human need to double-check it?

criteria.A: no, the automated routing is trustworthy
criteria.B: yes, a human should verify before acting
